problem: A variable force given by F(x) = 4x + 3 Newtons acts on a toy car. Find the total work done by this force as the car advances from x = 2 meters to x = 5 meters.

A 3.0 kg block slides at 6.0 m/s on a horizontal floor before colliding with a spring bumper (k = 500 N/m). If the kinetic friction coefficient is 0.25, find the spring's max compression. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
An industrial engine lifts 1500 kg of cargo to a height of 20 meters in 12 seconds. If the machine runs at 80% efficiency, calculate the electrical power input required.
A 12-gram bullet traveling horizontally at 350 m/s embeds into a 2.38 kg ballistic pendulum block. Find the mechanical energy lost as internal heat during this collision.
A force vector F = (2i - 4j + 5k) Newtons acts on an object, moving it from position r1 = (i + 3j) m to r2 = (4i - j + 2k) m. Determine the net work done.
The potential energy of a system is given by U(x) = (3/x) + 2x² Joules. Locate the coordinate x (where x > 0) where the system resides in stable equilibrium.
If the kinetic energy of a drone increases by exactly 96%, calculate the corresponding percentage increase in its linear momentum.
Gravel drops vertically onto a moving conveyor belt at a rate of 15 kg/s. If the belt travels at a constant speed of 4.0 m/s, find the extra power needed from the motor.
A 4.0 kg ball moving at 5 m/s makes a perfectly elastic head-on collision with a stationary 2.0 kg ball. Find the final velocity of the 2.0 kg ball.
A 0.6 kg block slides from rest down a curved slide from a height of 3.5 meters. If its speed at the bottom is 6.5 m/s, find the work done against friction. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A 3.0 kg body moves such that its displacement varies with time as x = 2t² - 4t meters. Find the power delivered to the body at t = 3.0 seconds.
A vertical toy launcher uses a spring compressed by 12 cm. If a 0.25 kg ball is placed on top and the spring (k = 300 N/m) is released, find the max height reached above launch. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A water jet with an area of 0.002 m² shoots horizontally at 8.0 m/s and hits a flat wall. If the water stops dead without bouncing, find the force on the wall. (Density = 1000 kg/m³)
A moving particle hits an identical stationary particle head-on. If the collision is perfectly elastic, what fraction of its kinetic energy remains with the first particle?
A small ball is tied to a 1.2-meter rigid light rod pivoted at one end. Find the minimum speed required at the bottom to swing the ball into a full vertical loop. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A 1200 kg car climbs a hill rising 1 meter for every 15 meters of track at a steady 20 m/s. If friction adds a constant resistive force of 400 N, find the engine's power output. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A laborer pushes a 10 kg box up a 6.0-meter ramp inclined at 30° at a slow, constant speed. If the kinetic friction coefficient is 0.20, find the total work done. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A 1.5 kg mass on a horizontal table is attached to a spring (k = 600 N/m). The spring is stretched by 8.0 cm and released. Find the velocity of the mass as it passes equilibrium.
A 0.3 kg rock is thrown at an angle from the ground with 150 Joules of kinetic energy. What is its kinetic energy at the peak of its flight if its launch angle was 45°?
A 1200 kg car moving East at 15 m/s crashes into a 1800 kg truck moving North at 10 m/s. They stick together. Calculate the mechanical kinetic energy lost to deformation.
A 4.0 kg bowling ball falls from a shelf 2.5 meters high onto a foam cushion. If the cushion compresses by 0.15 meters as it stops the ball, find the average stopping force. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A force field given by F = (2x i + 3y² j) Newtons acts on an object. Compute the work done moving it along a straight line from (0,0) to (3,2) meters.
A winch pulls a 500 kg boat up a frictionless ramp using a motor delivering a constant 1200 Watts. Find the velocity of the boat 8.0 seconds after starting from rest.
A bullet loses exactly 30% of its velocity after passing through a wooden board. What percentage of its kinetic energy was left behind inside the board?
A damper uses a non-linear spring with a force law F(x) = -80x - 150x³ Newtons. Calculate the potential energy stored when it is compressed by 0.20 meters.
A pool ball moving at 4.0 m/s strikes an identical stationary ball elastically. If the first ball deflects at 45° to its entry path, find the final speed of the second ball.
A 5.0 kg weight is spun in a vertical circle on a rope. Find the difference in rope tension between the very bottom and the very top of the loop. (g = 9.8 m/s²)
A 0.2 kg softball hits a wall horizontally at 25 m/s and bounces back along its path at 18 m/s. Find the net work done on the ball by the wall.
A wind turbine sweeps out an area of 5.0 m². If wind hits it at 12 m/s and the system converts 35% of the kinetic energy into power, find the output. (Air density = 1.2 kg/m³)
A rubber ball drops from a height of 5.0 meters onto concrete and bounces back to a peak height of 3.2 meters. Calculate the coefficient of restitution.
